zh: 货到了：选是哪一张采购单
en: Goods arrive: pick the purchase order

zh: 一样一样扫，系统对照订了多少
en: Scan each item; it checks against the order

zh: 坏了的写「损坏」，不会算进库存
en: Damaged goods are noted, not stocked

zh: 少了的会显示「少」，采购单会继续等
en: What is short stays on the order

zh: 完成：库存马上增加，收银和 app 都看得到
en: Done: stock goes up everywhere at once
